feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: NPR's expanded coverage of U.S. and world politics, the latest news from Congress and the White House and elections.

entry.title: Whistleblower claims USPS plan for Trump's mail voting order could 'derail' midterms
entry.summary: A whistleblower says the U.S. Postal Service is rushing out an online system for President Trump's push to restrict mail voting that could "derail" the midterm election if courts allow it to proceed.

entry.title: Judge to decide if Tyler Robinson will go to trial in Charlie Kirk murder case
entry.summary: Utah District Judge Tony Graf Jr. will hear arguments over evidence introduced in July, to decide if there's enough probable cause for a trial in the shooting of the conservative activist last year.

entry.title: Affordability is the centerpiece of Democrats' message in Pennsylvania swing district
entry.summary: A rematch in a swing district Pennsylvania is showcasing how Republican messaging from 2024 is getting a replay, this time from Democratic candidates.

entry.title: In Massachusetts, Sen. Ed Markey and Rep. Seth Moulton vie for Senate nomination
entry.summary: Sen. Ed Markey faces Congressman Seth Moulton in the Massachusetts Senate primary. Both candidates have similar progressive platforms.

entry.title: Trump officials cut political interference ban after unusual Census Bureau report
entry.summary: After the Census Bureau issued a report tied to a Trump-aligned think tank, the bureau's parent agency cut language banning political interference from its scientific integrity policy, NPR learned.

entry.title: Kalshi bans former congressman George Santos for life after State of the Union trades
entry.summary: Kalshi says Santos did not cooperate with its investigation into bets he placed on his own attendance at the State of the Union. The company also fined the disgraced congressman more than $71,000.

entry.title: Trump says U.S. struck deal to take control of 65 billion barrels Venezuelan oil
entry.summary: President Trump is touting a new deal for the U.S. to access Venezuelan oil fields. Trump says it's a major boon for the American people, but it's unclear when they'll see the benefits.

entry.title: Scholar discusses Trump's claims of a new Venezuelan oil agreement
entry.summary: NPR's A Martínez speaks with Francisco Monaldi, director of the Latin America Energy Program at Rice University, about President Trump's claims of a Venezuelan oil agreement.

entry.title: The U.S.-Venezuela oil deal won't lower your gas prices. Here's what you need to know
entry.summary: The Trump administration announced a deal Friday to develop a vast amount of Venezuela's oil reserves, with the U.S. taking a majority stake. Energy experts say there are many reasons to be skeptical.

entry.title: Funding bill at the top of the agenda as House returns from recess
entry.summary: The House returns Monday for one week before heading back home. At the top of the agenda is a bill to extend government funding past the midterm elections.
